items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Okay because there was a Bob Crosby.

ctx.x: Okay because there was a Bob Crosby.

Bill Cosby. But years ago Save a Band came to the State instead of going to the auditorium, I believe the classification was 18 pieces, and Bill Cosby came and he had Sarah Vaughan with him with a quartet, saying Bill Cosby was on the show and then Sarah Vaughan came with her quartet. So the local musicians, they had to bring in 16 more musicians, whatever it was, to make up that classification. And that’s the way it was. And so the union went a little too far sometimes.
